note: On a peninsula in Tims Ford Lake, separate from the park's Main Campground. The sites nearest the water are the east row (about 25-28) and the loop at the tip (39-42); the north row sits above a steep bank and the west row behind a strip of pines. --Claude
summary: Fairview checked on the park's camping page, campground map and the reservation calendar (8 two-week windows): 81 bookable back-in sites (+ host 71), 20/30/50 A + water, 29 sewer, rigs to 70 ft; $40-48 confirmed, $65 on July 4/Labor Day weekend nights; year-round; lakefront kept on the east row and tip loop only.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront KEPT, narrowly: east-row sites (map 25-28) at ~35.20009,-86.15887 / 35.20030,-86.15890 sit ~1.2-1.4 m above summer pool (pads 272.1-272.3 m vs 270.7 m) with ~25-30 m of open grass/dirt to the 888-ft line; the tip loop (39-42) at ~35.20102,-86.16166 is ~3 m above pool on a gentle open grade, ~37 m to the line. Not waterfront in the same sense: north row (28-35, ~35.20066,-86.15991) is ~35 m back behind a 3-4 m bank that drops in the last ~7 m (pads 273.4-274.1 m, crest 274.9-275.0 m) = lakeview; west row (46-58, ~35.19968,-86.16026) is only ~1 m above pool but behind a continuous pine strip = lakeview. Imagery is leaf-off winter drawdown.

PHONE: stored 931-962-1183 appears on none of the park's pages. Suggest 931-962-1183 -> 931-967-4230 (or the park office).
PRICE HIGH: $65 nights (holiday weekends) are above the US$50 gate but the base is $40; no gate issue.
SITES: count 82 -> 81 (the 82nd row is the host site); stored note's '31 sites add sewer' does not match the calendar's 29 public sewer sites (30 with the host).
PIN 35.19868,-86.15996 fine (inside the campground, ~100 m south of the loop centre).
